name: Autonomous Delivery Fleet Hub
prompt:
"Design an 'Autonomous Delivery Fleet Hub' app. The system must process a streaming-style API dataset containing: Drone ID, Battery %, Payload Weight, Target Destination, and Route Exception Flag (True/False).

The UI must feature:

An interactive telemetry grid tracking active vehicles.

A text input box called 'Command Prompt'. If the user types 'Recall low battery vehicles', the app must instantly filter the view to show only entries with Battery % < 20 and trigger a red warning animation on those specific rows.

A dynamic 'SLA Countdown Timer' column that ticks down in real-time seconds for each drone's remaining delivery window."

thought_process.interpretation: I have interpreted this request as a high-stakes Mission Control interface for a logistics fleet. The 'Autonomous Delivery Fleet Hub' focuses on real-time situational awareness, utilizing a command-driven UI to manage critical 'exceptions' like low battery levels. I prioritized a high-density telemetry grid combined with real-time countdown logic to meet the 'SLA' requirement.
skills_utilized: Memoized data processing for performance with large datasets
assumed_from_scratch: A custom 'Drone Lifecycle' simulator to generate 200 unique flight paths and telemetry states.
A real-time SLA decay engine that handles independent timers for hundreds of active entities.
A CSS-in-JS animation system for the 'Red Alert' state triggered by command inputs.
thought_process.skill_suggestions: Future iterations should include a 'Geofence Breach' alert component and a 'Payload Optimizer' that uses historical battery drain data to predict range more accurately.
